stances.reasoning: Rausch co-sponsored the Abortion Access Act (which goes beyond Roe Act to remove gestational limits and expand access broadly) per Act on Mass. She is also the primary sponsor of S.1244 ('An Act enhancing access to abortion care'), which was referred favorably to the Health Care Financing Committee. She separately filed SD.3722 to repeal pregnancy criminalization. Her record is the most expansive possible on abortion access.

Co-sponsored Stop Corporate Offshoring per Act on Mass and co-sponsored the Sunlight Act (campaign finance transparency) and Public Records Law bills. Her record of filing anti-lobbying loophole bills (S.2211) and lobbying agent disqualification (S.2209) shows strong commitment to limiting corporate and special-interest money in politics.

Co-sponsored Campaign Childcare bill per Act on Mass (providing childcare for campaign workers, reflecting broad childcare access policy). Co-sponsored THRIVE Act which includes childcare provisions. Her overall progressive record and Act on Mass co-sponsorships show support for major public investment in childcare access.

Co-sponsored CARE Act (anti-racism in education) per Act on Mass. Sponsored S.1246 (sex and gender as protected crime prosecution categories), S.1249 (body size discrimination prohibition), and S.1248 (public interest organizational standing for civil rights cases). Her record shows consistent work to strengthen civil rights enforcement and address systemic discrimination.

Co-sponsored 100% Renewable Energy by 2045 and Environmental Justice bills per Act on Mass. Her bill S.655 (water access equity) and S.654 (plastics reduction) reflect environmental justice focus. Her overall progressive record is consistent with rapid clean energy transition and phasing out fossil fuels.

Rausch filed five bills specifically targeting ICE enforcement: SD.3636 ('get ICE out of families'), SD.3638 ('de-ICE Massachusetts law enforcement'), SD.3639 ('support the pursuit of justice against ICE'), SD.3641 ('melt ICE defenses'), SD.3643 ('uncover ICE'). She also co-sponsored the Safe Communities Act per Act on Mass. This is the strongest possible evidence of opposing deportation enforcement and protecting undocumented immigrants.

Co-sponsored 100% Renewable Energy by 2045 and Environmental Justice bills per Act on Mass. Her environmental focus and progressive record are consistent with stopping new fossil fuel permits. No evidence of supporting an immediate ban on all existing extraction.

Co-sponsored Medicare for All (S.860) per Act on Mass. Also sponsored S.824 (pain medication coverage for IUD procedures), S.823 (post-pregnancy mental health care), S.1618 (community immunity promotion), and S.904 (health spending accountability). Her record consistently supports universal public healthcare coverage.

Co-sponsored Overdose Prevention Centers bill per Act on Mass, which would reduce criminalization of drug use and homelessness. Her progressive record is consistent with decriminalizing public sleeping and investing in shelter and services rather than enforcement.

Co-sponsored Lift the Ban on Local Tenant Protections (H.1477) per Act on Mass, which would allow municipalities to implement rent control. Sponsored S.1023 creating a Chapter 40B commission to investigate affordable housing permits. Her record shows support for tenant protections and rent stabilization alongside affordable housing production.

Filed five bills targeting ICE enforcement and co-sponsored the Safe Communities Act. Sponsored S.1248 (public interest organizational standing) which can be used by immigrant advocacy groups. Her record shows support for keeping immigration open and providing services regardless of status.

Co-sponsored Prison Moratorium (S.2114) per Act on Mass, making her one of its listed co-sponsors on the bill itself. Also co-sponsored Age of Criminal Majority to 21 and Overdose Prevention Centers per Act on Mass. Sponsored S.1758 (tear gas ban against civilians). Her record is the clearest support for redirecting incarceration funding to community-based alternatives.

Filed five bills targeting ICE enforcement at the state and local level, including bills to 'de-ICE Massachusetts law enforcement' and 'get ICE out of families.' Co-sponsored the Safe Communities Act which would prohibit local police from sharing immigration information with ICE. Her record clearly opposes all ICE detainers and restricts sharing of immigration status information.

Co-sponsored Medicare for All (S.860) per Act on Mass, which would extend Medicare to all Massachusetts residents regardless of age. Her consistent healthcare record supports the most expansive expansion of public health programs.

Did not co-sponsor Voting Rights Restoration bill. Rausch has championed voting access through S.527-S.534 (election bills including early voting, ranked choice, etc.) but there is no evidence she has specifically sponsored independent redistricting commission legislation. Her record on redistricting reform is not documented in available sources.

No direct bills on religious freedom. Her civil rights record sponsoring sex/gender protections, anti-discrimination bills, and LGBTQ-inclusive policies (Healthy Youth Act co-sponsorship via Act on Mass) places her in the camp of protecting LGBTQ and other civil rights over religious exemptions, without going to strict church-state separation.

Co-sponsored Healthy Youth Act (LGBTQ-inclusive sex education) per Act on Mass. Her comprehensive progressive record on LGBTQ rights and civil rights is unambiguous. No evidence of any position short of full marriage equality and federal protections.

Co-sponsored the Cherish Act (Fully Funded Public Higher Ed) per Act on Mass. Her record of championing public education funding and opposing corporate influence in public institutions is inconsistent with school vouchers. Co-sponsored THRIVE Act (education equity). Her record consistently prioritizes public education investment.

Co-sponsored Stop Corporate Offshoring (raises taxes on corporations) per Act on Mass. Her overall progressive revenue record is consistent with expanding Social Security by removing the payroll tax cap, though no specific MA state Social Security bill exists.

Co-sponsored Stop Corporate Offshoring per Act on Mass. Co-sponsored the Sunlight Act and corporate accountability bills. Her bill history includes S.904 (health spending accountability for large corporations) and anti-corporate-influence legislation. Her record strongly supports significantly raising taxes on wealthy individuals and large corporations.

Co-sponsored Healthy Youth Act (LGBTQ-inclusive health education) per Act on Mass. Her comprehensive progressive record on LGBTQ+ civil rights and explicit support for all LGBTQ+ protections is consistent with allowing all transgender athletes to compete on teams matching their gender identity without restrictions.
